JMBE 1.0.18 fixes Windows library creation on PCs with Smart App Control enabled. The Windows Creator downloads now include a trimmed official signed Java runtime and compiler. Build or update JMBE normally from VCE; no Windows security changes are required.

Voice decoding and audio behavior are unchanged from JMBE 1.0.17. Java 25 remains required. The Windows x64 Creator download is about 75 MiB. Existing working JMBE libraries continue to work.
